info.title: AssistantHub REST API
info.description: AssistantHub is a platform for building and managing AI assistants with RAG capabilities. It provides endpoints for managing users, credentials, assistants, documents, ingestion rules, embedding/completion endpoints, and chat interactions.

PassthroughObject.description: Pass-through JSON object returned by a subordinate service.

IndexRecord.description: Verbex index record. AssistantHub fills missing Name and CustomMetadata.ObjectName on create requests when possible.

SearchRequest.description: Verbex or RecallDB search request payload. Verbex index search supports opt-in enriched result fields.

Query.description: Search query text. Use * to browse Verbex index records.

MaxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return.

UseAndLogic.description: When true, all Verbex query terms must match.

IncludeMatchedTerms.description: Verbex index search only. Include MatchedTerms on each result.

IncludeTermDetails.description: Verbex index search only. Include per-term score/frequency details and MatchedTerms on each result.

IncludeDocumentTermStats.description: Verbex index search only. Include whole-document UniqueTermCount and TotalTermOccurrences.

SearchResponse.description: Verbex or RecallDB search response payload.

DocumentReindexRequest.description: Request body for document Verbex reindex operations.

DocumentIds.description: Optional explicit document identifiers to reindex.

IncludeAlreadyIndexed.description: When true, reindex documents even when Verbex metadata is already present.

DocumentReindexResult.description: Result for a single document Verbex reindex operation.

DocumentReindexBatchResult.description: Result for a batch document Verbex reindex operation.
